verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the official Sentry MCP server, which says it connects AI assistants to Sentry "for searching errors" and can be scoped to an organization or project. That shows a first-party search capability over events, but nothing describes its filters or syntax. missing for 10: documentation of a query syntax, filtering by tag, release and environment, filtering on custom properties, cross-project search in the main UI or API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
